title: AI Video Editor
description:
AI Video Editor | Seedance 2.5 | Wan 3 | Kling | higgsfield | Remote | Europe | €85k

I'm partnered with an innovative digital content business at the forefront of AI-generated media.

They are seeking a talented Mid/Senior AI Cinematic Video Editor to create engaging, narrative-driven video content using cutting-edge generative AI tools and workflows.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives at the intersection of storytelling, creativity, and emerging technology. You'll take ownership of the entire production process, transforming concepts into polished, cinematic content whilst helping to shape the future of AI-powered video production.

The Role
As a Mid/Senior AI Cinematic Video Editor, you will be responsible for creating long-form, story-focused content using advanced AI video generation tools and traditional post-production software. Working closely with the Content Lead, you'll drive projects from initial concept through to final delivery, maintaining exceptional visual quality and narrative consistency throughout.

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop scripts and creative concepts centred around existing AI-generated characters and intellectual property
  • Produce compelling long-form, narrative-driven video content with a strong emphasis on storytelling, pacing, atmosphere, and visual quality
  • Own end-to-end AI video production workflows, including prompting, generation, editing, compositing, and final delivery
  • Utilise leading AI video platforms including Kling, Seedance, Happy Horse, and other emerging technologies
  • Maintain character consistency, visual style, and scene continuity across longer-form productions
  • Apply motion graphics, visual effects, colour correction, and post-production techniques to elevate final outputs
  • Continuously experiment with new AI tools, workflows, and production techniques
  • Work autonomously whilst aligning with creative direction and production goals

About You
Essential Experience
  • 4+ years' experience in video production, VFX, motion design, digital art, or a related creative field
  • Demonstrable portfolio showcasing AI-generated video content
  • Hands-on experience with AI video generation tools and workflows
  • Strong knowledge of prompting techniques, content generation pipelines, consistency methods, and post-processing
  • Advanced proficiency with tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or equivalent editing software
  • Excellent understanding of cinematic storytelling, editing rhythm, composition, and visual language
  • Experience maintaining character and scene consistency across AI-generated sequences
  • Strong understanding of visual content production from concept through to delivery

Personal Attributes
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Highly self-motivated with strong ownership and accountability
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment
  • Naturally curious and passionate about emerging AI technologies
  • Confident experimenting with new tools and approaches
  • Adaptable, resilient, and open to feedback
  • Able to manage multiple priorities and iterate quickly

What's on Offer?
  • Opportunity to work with some of the most advanced AI video production tools available today
  • High levels of creative ownership and autonomy
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Collaborative and forward-thinking team culture
  • Direct influence on production processes and creative output
  • Exposure to cutting-edge developments within generative AI and digital media
